title: Juicy Slovakian Tomato Pasta
description: A low calorie, flavorful Slovakian dish featuring fresh tomatoes and pasta, perfect for a romantic dinner
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant
Add the tomato juice to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and garlic mixture
Reduce heat to low and simmer the sauce for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the tomato sauce
Toss the pasta in the sauce, ensuring it is well coated
Season with salt and black pepper to taste
Garnish with chopped fresh basil and serve hot
